formulas.cycle: Total Cycle Time = Loading (Sec) + Process (Sec) + Unloading and Cleaning (Sec) + Other Operations (Sec).
formulas.shift: Machine Shift Time = MOD(Machine OFF Time − Machine ON Time, 1) × 24
formulas.idealQty: Ideal Quantity = FLOOR(Machine Shift Time × 3600 ÷ Total Cycle Time) — the most the shift could make, so Actual Quantity can't be more than this.
formulas.pctOk: % OK Quantity = OK Quantity ÷ (OK Quantity + Rejected Quantity)
formulas.unutilized: Unutilized Machine Time = (12 − (Shift Hours − Lunch ÷ 60)) ÷ 11, for this entry alone. Shown as 0% when the result is below 0 and 100% when it is above 100.
formulas.totalStoppage: Total Stoppage = Lunch / Rest + the downtime columns opened here: Setup Time … Other.
formulas.effective: Effective Machine Run Time = OK Quantity × Total Cycle Time ÷ 3600, shown as hours:minutes (753 × 57 s = 11:55).
formulas.unreported: Unreported Time (min) = Planned Operator Shift − Effective Run Time − Total Stoppage, in whole minutes, combined across every entry of this machine's date — so every entry of that machine/date shows the same figure.
formulas.setupEff: Setup Efficiency = Effective Machine Run Time ÷ Machine Shift Time
formulas.oeeLosses: OEE considering losses = Effective Run Time ÷ (Available Hours − Total Downtime ÷ 60), combined across every entry of this machine's date.
formulas.oeeLunch: OEE not considering losses but lunch = Effective Run Time ÷ (Available Hours − Lunch ÷ 60), combined across every entry of this machine's date.
formulas.oeeLunchCot: OEE not considering losses but lunch and setup time = Effective Run Time ÷ (Available Hours − Lunch ÷ 60 − Setup Time ÷ 60), combined across every entry of this machine's date.
formulas.availability: Availability = Operating Time ÷ Planned Production Time, for this entry. Operating Time = Machine Shift − every stoppage; Planned Production Time = Planned Operator Shift − Lunch − Planned Down Time (the planned stops). Above 100% (red) sends the entry to Admin review.
formulas.performance: Performance = Cycle Time × (OK + Rejected) ÷ Operating Time, for this entry — how fast it ran against its ideal speed. Above 100% (red) sends the entry to Admin review: usually a wrong cycle time, quantity or stoppage.
formulas.quality: Quality = OK Quantity ÷ (OK + Rejected), for this entry.
formulas.review: Admin review: an entry whose Availability, Performance or Quality is above 100% is held as Pending review until an Admin or Super Admin approves or rejects it. Editing the figures sends it back for review; hover for details.
